payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute binomial coefficients modulo 1e9+7 using precomputed factorials and inverse factorials; then derive coefficients for each element based on parity of n to sum the final result.
payload.rationale: The algorithm directly computes combinatorial coefficients via factorials (DP precomputation) rather than searching; the final coefficient pattern matches binomial coefficients, classic dp_counting_combinatorics.
